title: Live calls
nobody_live: Nobody is on the line right now.
idle_note: The line is registered and Lena is on duty, so anything that comes in will appear here.
live_gruber_duty: Lena is on this call. You can whisper to her, take over, or hand the caller to reception.
live_night_duty: The out-of-hours assistant is taking a message. Nobody at the business is expected to pick up.
live_hoffmann_urgent: On hold 0:18 — nobody has picked up
live_hoffmann_duty: Transferred to reception and still ringing. If nobody answers in the next few seconds, take it yourself.
duty_offline: Nothing can be dialled while the line is down. Lena stays on duty and will answer as soon as it is back.
duty_idle: Lena is on duty and answers within two rings. Dial out, or call yourself to hear how she sounds.
listen_on_note: You are hearing the call. Neither side knows — your microphone stays off until you take over.
listen_off_note: Hear the call live without joining it. Nobody is told, so use it to check on a new assistant, not on staff.
whisper_title: Type an instruction only Lena hears. She says it in her own voice.
whisper_note: The caller will not hear you. Lena says it in her own voice.
whisper_placeholder: Tell the assistant what to say…
takeover_title: Speak to the caller yourself. Lena stops talking and keeps listening.
handoff_title: Ring the business phones and pass the caller to whoever picks up.
muted_note: You are muted — the caller hears nothing from you. Lena is not speaking either, so they are hearing silence.
speaking_note: You are speaking to the caller. Lena has stopped talking but is still transcribing, so the record stays complete.
dial_offline: Dialling is disabled while the line is offline.
task_note: Lena dials the number, delivers your message, and writes down the answer. Useful for reminders and confirmations.
confirm_takeover_body: The caller hears a short tone, then you. Lena stops speaking but keeps transcribing, so the record stays complete. She does not come back unless you hand the call to her again.
confirm_end_body: The caller hears the line go dead, mid-sentence if that is where you are. There is no way to reconnect this call — only to ring them back, from a number they may not recognise. The other {count} calls carry on.
confirm_handoff_body: Every desk phone and the DECT handset ring for 20 seconds. If nobody picks up the caller comes back to Lena, and this is written into the call record either way.
offline_title: Phone line offline — you cannot dial out and nobody can reach you
offline_body_after: . Use a mobile phone until it is back.
error_title: This tab lost its connection to the call server
error_body: The live stream to this page dropped, so you cannot dial or follow a call from here. Calls themselves are unaffected — the assistant is still answering. Reconnect, or pick calls up on a desk phone.
dial_device: Rings on {device} first, then connects the caller.
